items.quote: Rebecki is wild, his cardio is like kind of all over the place

items.claim: Mateusz Rebecki has strong wrestling skills.
items.quote: he has wrestling, and he should be able to beat Kyle literally everywhere.

items.claim: Bogdan Grad has straightforward striking centered around jabs and setups.
items.quote: He's got solid striking. His striking is very straightforward. He sticks to jabs. He has setups.

items.claim: Bogdan Grad attacks the legs early with heavy kicks to slow opponents down.
items.quote: He's got heavy kicks, he invests in the legs early to try to slow you down.

items.claim: Bogdan Grad focuses on control rather than submissions when he wrestles.
items.quote: he'll focus on control more than submissions.

items.claim: Bogdan Grad is coming off a second-round knockout loss to Luke Riley.
items.quote: He's coming off that knockout loss to Luke Riley where he was having early success, especially with the wrestling, but then he was knocked out in the second round.

items.claim: Denis Bazooka lacks a durable chin.
items.quote: He doesn't have much of a chin, but he is tough

items.claim: Denis Bazooka underutilizes his wrestling ability.
items.quote: he doesn't really threaten the wrestling as much as he should considering how good of a wrestler he actually is.

items.claim: Denis Bazooka is coming off a left hook knockout loss to Mauricio Barbosa.
items.quote: He is coming off that left hook knockout loss to Mauricio Barbosa.

items.claim: Bogdan Grad is undersized compared to Denis Bazooka.
items.quote: Bogdan is undersized. I know it only looks like a 1-in difference here. Dennis is going to be significantly larger.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira throws extreme volume and high pace in his striking.
items.quote: Michael Oliveira is an insanely fast and busy striker. He loves to close the distance, and then he'll throw what feels like 200 strikes a minute.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira possesses fantastic knockout power.
items.quote: He also has fantastic power. So, if it lands clean while throwing in that ridiculous volume, he can put you to sleep.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira's takedown defense is relatively untested.
items.quote: His takedown defense is just okay, but it's relatively untested in that department.

items.claim: Oban Elliott has grappling holes that were exploited by Jonathan Micallef.
items.quote: If he is taken down, there are definitely grappling holes, and those holes were just recently exploited against Jonathan Micallef, where he was clearly the better striker, but he got taken down and submitted.
